title: The Real Reason Pirates Wore Eye Patches #Shorts
description:
Pirates wore eye patches... but probably not for the reason you think. There's a popular theory: keep one eye covered, so it's ready for the dark below deck. Your eyes really do need many minutes to adjust to darkness, so the trick could work.
